patch.summary: Update an Asset Allocation Template Assignment's overrides
patch.description: Replaces the assignment's overrides, recomputes materialized_config from the assigned published version, and updates the account's sleeves the same way create does. The sleeve changes are listed in sleeve_results. Send the revision you last read as expected_revision. If the assignment was saved after that, nothing is written and the response is 409 stale_revision. If accounts refuses the sleeve update, nothing is saved, on the assignment or the account, and the response is 409 sleeve_push_rejected. If accounts gives no clear answer the change is kept, still applying, and the response is 202 with the assignment; reading it by id finishes it, and the revision says whether it was applied. If an earlier change is still being applied, nothing is written and the response is 409 change_in_flight.

post.summary: Preview an Asset Allocation Template Assignment update
post.description: Plans a candidate override set exactly as the update would — same resolution, validation and sleeve plan — and writes nothing: no assignment, buffer cash, or sleeve changes. Invalid overrides get the same 400 conflicts as the update. The sleeve plan can still differ from the save's if the account's sleeves change in between, and accounts-side refusals only surface on the save.

AllocationTemplateNode.description: A node in the template tree. It holds either child nodes or a strategy menu, never both; cash holds neither. A model_category is a section defined by strategy tags — those tags filter which strategies show up in menus under it, and at least one is required. Ordinary sections and cash must not carry tags.

id.description: Stable node id ('aatn_' ULID). Minted server-side for new nodes: omit or send empty on creation, keep it verbatim on later publishes - child overrides are keyed by it.

name.description: Display name; the root node may have an empty name

kind.description: What this node is. A node is a free-text section; a model_category is a section defined by strategy tags; cash is the funding buffer.

relative_weight.description: The node's share of its parent as a decimal string (never a number). Null means unset; the root carries an implicit 100% and keeps this null.

min_weight.description: Optional lower range bound in relative-weight terms, as a decimal string

max_weight.description: Optional upper range bound in relative-weight terms, as a decimal string

tag_ids.description: Strategy tag ids from the tags service. Required on a model_category (at least one). Must be omitted or empty on ordinary sections and cash. A nested model_category cannot reuse a tag already set by an ancestor.

children.description: Child nodes; mutually exclusive with strategies

AllocationTemplateOverrides.description: A linked template's delta against its base, keyed by stable node id. Field semantics are tri-state and load-bearing: an absent field inherits from the base, an explicit null is an unset/clear override, a value is an override. Per node: relative_weight/min_weight/max_weight plus a strategies map keyed by strategy id with relative_weight/min_weight/max_weight (value overrides), added (child-added entry), and removed (child-removed base entry). Typed loosely so absent and null survive the wire.
